tiers.label: Light check
tiers.meaning: Owner skims the receipt and spot-checks one item.

tiers.label: Focused review
tiers.meaning: Owner reads only the members listed under 'Read these'.

tiers.label: Full read
tiers.meaning: Owner reads every non-generated change line by line.

areas.name: Security-sensitive code
areas.why: Untrusted-input deserialization (typeless, hash-collision limits) and runtime code emission; a change here can open a remote-code-execution or DoS hole.

areas.name: Wire format
areas.why: Serialized bytes are a compatibility contract with every client that has ever written data.

areas.name: Public attributes
areas.why: Attributes are public API that users put in their own code; removing or renaming them breaks builds.

areas.name: Generated code templates
areas.why: Templates change the code generated inside every consuming project.

areas.name: Analyzer and generator logic
areas.why: Decides which diagnostics users see and what gets generated.

silencingPatterns.why: Comment or code says something is being dropped or suppressed.
An exception is caught and discarded.
A report is now conditional; some reports will no longer happen.

earnedTrust.note: An area with this many accepted sign-offs and no escapes drops one review tier. Any escape in an area forces a full read there until trust is re-earned.
